use_deprecated_decorator: use the deprecated decorator to mark a function as deprecated with a custom warning message
create_autoround_formatter: create an AutoRoundFormatter instance to colorize log output by level with ANSI escape codes
log_warning_once: log a warning message only once per unique message using the warning_once method on the logger
add_trace_logging: add a TRACE level logging method to any Logger instance for verbose debug output
add_infoclean_logging: add an INFOCLEAN level logging method to output plain messages without timestamp or level prefix
